messages:
Maya: kicking off a quick thread — prepping the EBR slides for Northlane tomorrow. I updated the draft with the health dashboard screenshots.
Jordan: thanks maya. can you call out renewal risks on slide 4? finance wants ARR impact numbers.
Maya: yep — added a ‘Renewal Risk’ card but need exact churn / ARR delta. @Priya can you confirm the latest renewal signal?
Priya: pulling the latest from Gainsight now, should have numbers in ~30m. FYI there’s a new stakeholder added: CTO is joining exec review.
Alex: flag — eng asked for a simplified perf slide (p95 latency) not the full histogram. keeps deck tighter.
Sam: i can take the perf slide, will pull last 7 days from telemetry. one ask: do we want a canary / fallback note for the model rollout?
Maya: yes include a 1-liner under reliability section: "canary in us-west, automatic fallback to v1". Alex — can you add the short bullet?
Alex: on it. also adding a note: projected savings if we enable batching = ~18% token cost (per Redwood Optimize sim).
Jordan: great. action items: (1) Priya — confirm ARR delta and renewal owner (2) Sam — perf slide by EOD (3) Alex — reliability + batched savings bullet (4) Maya — finalize slides and send to execs.
Priya: ARR delta = $72k ARR at risk, renewal owner = Claire (account exec). tagging Claire in the doc.
Maya: got it. Claire looped in doc: https://redwood.com/docs/EBR/1758502468 — added a CTA for a pre-brief call with Claire + Jordan.
ops-bot: Reminder: EBR prep meeting scheduled in 4 hours — Calendar invite sent to participants.
Jordan: quick check — who will run the live demo? we should have a fallback recording.
Sam: i’ll run live. @Alex can you keep a recording available (or failover to recorded demo)?
Alex: will do. uploading recording to the slide notes after Sam confirms flow.
Maya: timeline: finish slides by 3pm, quick run at 4pm, final deck to execs by 5pm. if anything slips call it out here asap.
Priya: updated the renewal slide with $72k and a 2-week enablement window to reduce risk. left two suggested asks for execs.
Jordan: perfect. maya — once you send to execs, add a short TL;DR email: 3 bullets (health, risk, ask).
Maya: will do. thanks team — i’ll post final link here when sent. :thumbsup:
Maya: (sent) final deck to execs + Claire. link: https://redwood.com/docs/EBR/final-1758502468 — added runbook and recording.
Jordan: :raised_hands: nice work. closing thread, move to #calendar for meeting updates.
